subtext: APR 70 Pictures is a small company. We hire carefully and we keep the people we hire.

sections.heading: If you want to work here.
sections.body:
APR 70 is not a large studio. We do not post open positions on a rolling basis, run a development assistant pipeline, or hire for roles that do not yet exist. What we do is build — a slate, a company, a standard. If you believe in that project and have skills that serve it, we want to hear from you.

We hire writers, producers, production staff, and people with specific technical expertise we do not yet have in-house. We are not interested in titles. We are interested in people who do the work.

sections.heading: The kind of people we hire.
sections.body:
People who watch films and remember them. People who can tell you exactly what was wrong with the last three things they saw, and exactly what was right. People who have read the trades for years without being asked to. People who understand that a small company with a clear vision is a better place to do serious work than a large company with a diffuse one.

Relevant experience matters. So does taste. The two are not always the same thing.

sections.heading: Get in touch.
sections.body:
Send a brief note — one page or less — describing who you are, what you do, and why APR 70 is a fit. Include a resume or equivalent. Do not send a form letter. If you want to work here, the note you send should make that legible.

Email: submissions@aprpictures.com
Subject line: JOBS — [Your Name / Role]
